description: **CI watcher prints to stderr.** The background CI watcher now writes results to inherited stderr instead of attempting tty detection. AI agents and terminal users both see CI pass/fail in their output stream. On failure, the GitHub Actions run URL is printed.

**`*.local-only` gitignore pattern.** Scaffolded `.gitignore` now includes `*.local-only`. Use a `.local-only/` directory or `*.local-only` suffix to keep files out of version control without per-file gitignore entries.
